biotools.summary: PyFgsea is a high-performance Python framework, built on Rust, for conducting Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA). It specializes in trajectory-aware rolling-window enrichment, matching the performance of the R fgseaMultilevel estimator for single-cell data analysis.
